title: Planes
content: In my “ mall world “ it’s always sunny and hot, there’s multiple malls you can drive too and a airport, with a gas station on the way with a play area inside it. My dream alwyss ends with me dying in a plane crash, like the plane will be going down and I will just teleport out of the plane onto the ground and then I see the plane crash from outside the plane. Always the same airport, always the same crash. Any similar experiences with the planes?
